boundary_condition: Apply only to hotel room bed-configuration choices; do not infer preferences about hotel location, price, dates, party size, or non-bed amenities.
condition: When searching for a hotel room or specifying room amenities and no separate-bed requirement is stated.
default_action: Filter for or request a room with a king-sized bed as the preferred bed configuration.
exception_condition: If a king-sized bed is unavailable or a stated need requires separate beds, continue with another suitable bed configuration rather than blocking the booking solely on the king-bed preference.
name: Requests a king-sized bed for hotel rooms
rationale: Across independent hotel dialogues, the room amenity requests consistently include a king-sized bed. This supports a scoped synthetic default for hotel room bed configuration, without extending it to unrelated room amenities or trip details.

source_evidence.contribution: User includes "a king-sized bed" among requested room amenities.
User says, "I need ... a king-sized bed," making the bed configuration explicit.
User says they are looking for "a king-sized bed" as part of the hotel room request.
User says, "I need a king-sized bed," directly supporting the default.
User lists "a king-sized bed" among room features that the room needs to have.

source_examples.user_utterance: In room amenities, balcony view, if possible and a king-sized bed, free-breakfast.
On top of that, I need a flat-screen TV and a king-sized bed.
I would like a fitness center, a pool, and a hot tub. I'm also looking for an ocean view, a balcony, a king-sized bed.
I need a king-sized bed with a balcony.
